title: SOC Operations - Wazuh
description: Dashboard specification for Wazuh/OpenSearch SOC monitoring.

filters.high_risk: rule.level >= 9 OR rule.groups: soc_risk_high OR rule.groups: soc_risk_critical

panels.name: High/Critical Alerts by Level
panels.purpose: Show immediate SOC queue pressure by severity.

panels.name: Critical Alerts by Agent
panels.purpose: Show which assets are producing critical alerts.

panels.name: SOC Alert Trend by Severity
panels.purpose: Show alert load and severity trend.

panels.name: High and Critical Risk Alerts
panels.query: rule.level >= 9 OR rule.groups: soc_risk_high OR rule.groups: soc_risk_critical

panels.name: pfSense Firewall Correlations
panels.purpose: Show repeated block detections and noisy network sources.

panels.name: Snort IDS Risk
panels.purpose: Show actionable IDS alerts without priority-3 noise.

panels.name: Privileged Authentication
panels.query: rule.groups: privileged_logon OR rule.id:(100401 OR 100410 OR 100412 OR 17101)

panels.name: Agent Telemetry Freshness
panels.purpose: Confirm active log collection by agent.
